channel.title: ALTRENDAT
channel.description: What the world is searching for, explained with sources

item.title: Manchester United Sacks Michael Carrick Following Worst Ever Premier League Season Start
item.description: Manchester United has sacked head coach Michael Carrick after he oversaw only one win in 10 matches, leaving the club in the relegation zone.

item.title: Over 700 Scottish schools hit by hoax bomb threats targeting students
item.description: More than 700 schools in Scotland and Northern Ireland received bomb threats that authorities have assessed as non-credible hoaxes.

item.title: System crash forces 40,000 students to abandon digital NCEA English exam
item.description: A major technical outage hit the NCEA Level 2 English exam across New Zealand this morning, forcing students to switch to paper or accept derived grades.

item.title: Knicks host Cavaliers as Cleveland seeks revenge for recent 109-97 home defeat
item.description: The Cleveland Cavaliers face the New York Knicks at Madison Square Garden on Wednesday night in an Eastern Conference rematch.

item.title: Singapore Airlines defends controversial business class seats after viral dental chair comparisons
item.description: Singapore Airlines addressed public criticism regarding its new business class cabin color palette following the November 6 unveiling of a $1.6 billion fleet revamp.

item.title: Dublin Pizza Max shuttered after discovery of extensive active rodent infestation
item.description: Health officials ordered the immediate closure of Pizza Max on Talbot Street after finding rodent droppings in food preparation areas.

item.title: Over 7,000 Schools Across Europe Hit by Wave of Bomb Hoaxes
item.description: More than 6,300 Italian schools and over 700 across Scotland and Northern Ireland received bomb threats that authorities have labeled as not credible.

item.title: Ultra Lotto jackpot hits P512 million as no ticket matches winning numbers
item.description: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office announced that no bettors matched the winning combination of 56-41-37-23-18-14 for the November 10, 2026 draw.

item.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Smashes Microsoft Store Records Ahead of November Launch
item.description: Grand Theft Auto VI launches on consoles and via XBOX Cloud Gaming on November 19, following record-breaking pre-order numbers.

item.title: Irish unions suspend nationwide public sector strike after securing major pay deal
item.description: Trade unions have called off a nationwide strike planned for November 12 after reaching a new 10.75% pay agreement with the government.

item.title: Dua Lipa, Tame Impala, SZA, Daddy Yankee Clinch 2027 Coachella Festival Headlining Slots
item.description: Coachella returns to Indio for two weekends in April 2027 with a stacked lineup featuring four top-billed artists and a new sale of passes.

item.title: Severe storms trap vehicles and trigger widespread road closures across New Zealand
item.description: MetService warns of heavy rain and hazardous flooding as emergency crews respond to stranded vehicles near Tokoroa.

item.title: Knicks enter Kith Night as massive 15.5-point favorites against struggling Bucks
item.description: The surging New York Knicks host the 1-9 Milwaukee Bucks at 7:30 p.m. ET on Tuesday at Madison Square Garden.

item.title: Public Sector Strike Looms As Fifty Thousand Workers Prepare For Nationwide Rallies
item.description: Irish public sector unions are weighing a revised pay offer while maintaining strike plans for Thursday as negotiations continue at the Workplace Relations Commission.

item.title: Chiefs acquire Josh Downs from Colts in late deadline day trade
item.description: The Kansas City Chiefs secured wide receiver Josh Downs and a 2027 seventh-round pick from the Indianapolis Colts in exchange for two future draft selections.

item.title: Bills Shore Up Secondary By Acquiring League-Leading Interceptor Amani Hooker From Titans
item.description: The Buffalo Bills acquired veteran safety Amani Hooker from the Tennessee Titans at the NFL trade deadline in exchange for a second-round draft pick.

item.title: Nvidia Stock Plunges 10% Over CEO Jensen Huang Chinese Intelligence Affair Probe
item.description: Nvidia’s board hired law firm Wachtell Lipton to investigate CEO Jensen Huang following his admission of an affair with a suspected Chinese intelligence operative.

item.title: Jim Jordan Clinches House GOP Leader Spot Defeating Scalise By 33 Votes
item.description: Jim Jordan secured the position of House GOP minority leader after defeating Steve Scalise in a closed-door secret ballot vote on Tuesday.

item.title: 49ers bolster receiving corps by acquiring Keenan Allen from the Colts
item.description: The San Francisco 49ers acquired wide receiver Keenan Allen from the Indianapolis Colts in exchange for a 2027 sixth-round draft pick.

item.title: Chelsea Held to Scoreless Draw in Women's Champions League Clash Against Hacken
item.description: Chelsea and Swedish side Hacken ended their UEFA Women's Champions League encounter in a 0-0 stalemate.

item.title: SASSA Sprints Through December Grant Payments Starting December 2 Across Three Days
item.description: The South African Social Security Agency confirmed December 2026 grant disbursements will occur from December 2 to December 4.

item.title: GTA 6 Clings to 30 FPS on PS5 Pro as Upgrades Revealed
item.description: Rockstar Games confirmed GTA 6 will maintain 30 frames per second on all consoles when it launches on November 19.

item.title: England mandates total phone ban as pupils face strict September 2027 rules
item.description: The government is strengthening guidance to ensure truly phone-free school days by prohibiting students from keeping mobile devices in their bags or pockets.

item.title: Troy Aikman jokes about needing loan during ESPN contract standoff with network
item.description: Analyst Troy Aikman quipped about his finances on air while calling the Bills' 23-6 victory over the Vikings amid stalled contract extension talks.

item.title: DSWD Distributes P189 Million to Farmers Devastated by El Niño Drought Conditions
item.description: The Department of Social Welfare and Development has released over P189 million in emergency cash and food packs to support drought-stricken farmers as of November 7.

item.title: Hamilton rain washout forces Black Caps into desperate fight for series draw
item.description: Heavy rain at Seddon Park abandoned the third ODI between New Zealand and India, leaving the hosts trailing 2-0 in the series.

item.title: Singaporeans Secure Final Assurance Package Cash Payouts of Up To $250
item.description: Approximately 3 million Singaporean adults will receive final Assurance Package cash payouts ranging from $100 to $250 starting December 8.

item.title: DC Studios Ousts James Gunn and Peter Safran, Names Jeremy Latcham President
item.description: James Gunn and Peter Safran are stepping down as co-CEOs of DC Studios on December 1st, replaced by Jeremy Latcham.

item.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Pre-Downloads Start November 10 Ahead of Launch
item.description: Rockstar Games confirmed that Grand Theft Auto VI will launch on November 19, with pre-downloads beginning on November 10 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

item.title: Two Lucky Winners Split Massive $12.2 Million Toto Jackpot In Singapore
item.description: Two winning tickets shared the $12,198,558 Group 1 jackpot following the Toto cascade draw held on Nov 9.

item.title: NBC Omits National Anthem From Sunday Night Football Broadcast At Soldier Field
item.description: NBC did not broadcast the national anthem during Sunday night's game at Soldier Field despite the NFL's Salute to Service week.

item.title: England storms to record 45-22 victory over Australia in Nations Championship
item.description: Steve Borthwick's side delivered a clinical seven-try performance against Australia at Allianz Stadium to secure their highest-ever points tally against the Wallabies.

item.title: Jaguars Acquire Pro Bowl Safety Jessie Bates in Massive Trade Deadline Deal
item.description: The Jacksonville Jaguars have traded a 2027 second-round pick and a 2028 fifth-round pick to the Atlanta Falcons for safety Jessie Bates.

item.title: Fermin Lopez Brace Fires Barcelona To Comeback Win At Atletico Madrid
item.description: Barcelona secured a vital comeback victory against Atletico Madrid with two goals from Fermin Lopez, ensuring they head into the international break at the top of LaLiga.

item.title: Jonathan Taylor Bids Emotional Farewell To Colts As November Trade Deadline Looms
item.description: Pro Bowl running back Jonathan Taylor addressed his potential departure from Indianapolis following the team's fifth consecutive loss.

item.title: Georgia Bulldogs Surge to No. 1 After 42-7 Rout of Ole Miss
item.description: Georgia takes the top spot in the AP Poll following a dominant win and Miami's loss to Notre Dame.

item.title: Sunny skies and breezy conditions forecast for Kauai this coming Monday
item.description: Kauai residents can expect mostly sunny weather on Monday, November 9, 2026, with coastal highs reaching up to 90 degrees.

item.title: Fermin Lopez brace powers Barcelona past Atletico Madrid to defend top spot
item.description: Barcelona secured a 2-1 comeback victory over Atletico Madrid on Sunday to maintain their lead in the La Liga table.

item.title: Bookmakers install actress Bethany Antonia as 2/1 favorite for Strictly elimination
item.description: Bethany Antonia enters the upcoming Strictly Come Dancing Halloween special as the favorite to exit the competition according to the latest betting odds.

item.title: Chiefs Rout Reeling Jets 35-12 To Deepen Season Tailspin For New York
item.description: The Kansas City Chiefs secured a dominant 35-12 victory over the New York Jets, handing the Jets their fourth consecutive loss.
